# B"H
<!-- Boruch Hashem -->
<!-- Blessed is He -->

# Phase Three: Final Critique Before Execution

> The Awtsmoos gives each candidate one honest trial while production remains the guarded shore;
> Awtsmoos.com compares timing, truth, and movement before allowing any further door.

## Final Questions

1. Does the local generated bundle actually contain the deferred scheduler boundary described by its tests?
2. Does that scheduler import resolve when served from the repository proof server?
3. Does essential readiness settle before the twenty-second timeout?
4. Does full readiness return without blocking the launcher promise?
5. Does the bootstrap minimap mount once and transfer ownership once?
6. Does rich UI preserve inventory and equipment state instead of replacing it destructively?
7. Does local-tab multiplayer show both players in both pages?
8. Does optional chat mount without timer-throttling in local-tab mode?
9. Does server-style transport defer chat without harming readiness or movement?
10. Does the candidate reduce cold-start time relative to the 11.138-second production proof?
11. Are request counts and JavaScript bytes lower without new 404s?
12. Does the candidate preserve the exact Drive model URLs?
13. Does it avoid altering the route shell hardening?
14. Are all current source files below 120 lines?
15. Does every changed file have a corresponding behavioral proof?
16. Is the local compact artifact reproducible from current source?
17. Are any changes owned by another active process?
18. Can the candidate be validated without writing or regenerating anything?
19. Can failures be reported without touching the candidate?
20. Is there any reason to disturb the proven production release before all answers are green?

## Final Decision

The next execution pass is read-only. It will run source tests, inspect exact diffs, launch the current working tree through the existing browser proof harness, record timing and runtime receipts, and compare results with production. Any red gate becomes a written audit finding, not an automatic code rewrite.
